summary: Recognize the macOS shared system directory in public repository scans

rules.detail: The public-content scanner recognizes only the exact case-sensitive macOS shared directory as system-owned rather than personal. Personal homes, lookalike names and parent-directory traversals remain flagged. The history scanner picks up this policy after it lands in its pinned base.

compatibility.detail: No runtime behavior or public API change.

recovery.detail: Revert the scanner policy change to restore the former classification.
